record.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is accepted primitive bronze-age olive beam press. Preserve EXACT mechanical geometry, left pivot, right beam guide, long lever, hanging stone counterweight, compression strut, pressing block, circular stone basin and timber supports. Empty variant: remove olives and liquid and receptacle contents; basin holds only an empty natural reed pressing mat. Keep every wood beam rough-hewn and slightly irregular with broken grain, not smoothly polished. The pressing block remains vertically in contact with mat under beam. Full final height80px width about110px. WorldSim style05 ink-and-tone, fine irregular warm brown-black pen edges over restrained translucent ochre/stone washes, outer contour twice inner line. Quiet broad base and subtle lower-right shadow tone, mild pigment variation only, no stipples, flaked watercolor, dense hatching, smooth plastic or vector shapes. Wood: 3 broken longitudinal grain marks per principal timber; stone/clay: 3 short crack/facet groups; rope only sparse twist. At most one group of 3 parallel / hatching marks. Upper-left daylight; tops/left brighter and lower/right darker. Front three-quarter about20deg above, substantial visible front planes. Single isolated full object, generous actual transparent margins and gaps, no ground, cast-shadow puddle, glow, haze, labels, people, roof, modern features or background. Preserve warm natural materials and organic contour. No dyed fabric.
record.subject: one bronze-age primitive olive beam press: two upright timber posts holding one long horizontal wood lever beam, natural rope lashings and hanging stone counterweight, low circular stone pressing basin beneathbeam, empty reed pressing mat, no iron screw or gears or roof.
